# zaktabyte

> Personal site of zaktabyte (also known as hXR16F), a tech enthusiast and self-taught hobbyist programmer and cybersecurity enthusiast from Poland. Focus areas: Python, automation, Linux, cybersecurity, homelab projects, self-hosted infrastructure, local AI, and open source. Site title: "zaktabyte — Hobbyist Programmer & Cybersecurity Enthusiast".

The site is a single page with these sections: Main, About, Stack, Projects, Mentions ("Featured In"). Footer: "Made with ❤ by zaktabyte".

## About the author

- Wrote first lines of code at the age of 9 out of pure curiosity and never stopped.
- Specializes in developing custom solutions, automating complex processes to improve efficiency and productivity, and exploring the depths of cybersecurity through research and practical application.
- Learns by building: if something isn't understood, takes it apart and builds a custom version. Projects span web development, automation, cybersecurity, self-hosted infrastructure, local AI, and software experimentation, often starting as small ideas and growing into fully functional tools.
- Most work is open source on GitHub, where repositories have accumulated over 200 stars.
- Projects have drawn attention from security researchers at Zscaler and Security Boulevard.
- Several repositories are preserved in the GitHub Arctic Code Vault.
- Maintains a homelab on an HP ProDesk 600 G3 SFF running Proxmox, with services like Pi-hole, n8n, MCP servers and more.
- Actively takes part in cybersecurity challenges on TryHackMe, ranked in the Top 1% globally.
- Semi-finalist at the Pix Programming Challenge on "Master" difficulty in 2020.

## Featured projects

- [1000420.xyz](https://1000420.xyz/): A playful digital experimentation platform offering a curated collection of interactive tools and mini-experiments to explore, tinker with, and enjoy. Tags: Python, Flask, API
- [PocketRecon-AI](https://github.com/hXR16F/PocketRecon-AI): Lightweight MCP server that gives local LLMs AI-powered cybersecurity reconnaissance capabilities; runs on low-power devices like Raspberry Pi. Tags: Python, MCP, Cybersecurity
- [AntiAV](https://github.com/hXR16F/AntiAV): A tool that makes any file undetectable by antivirus software using obfuscation techniques. Tags: Batch, Cybersecurity
- [Stealth-Fingerprinter](https://github.com/hXR16F/stealth-fingerprinter): A sophisticated URL-based tracking system featuring bot detection, obfuscation capabilities and advanced endpoint management. Tags: Python, Flask
- [Progress-Bar](https://github.com/hXR16F/progress-bar): A fancy and customizable progress bar for batch scripts, with real-time visual feedback during execution and a completion summary when finished. Tags: Batch, Utility
- [OmegleBOT](https://github.com/hXR16F/OmegleBOT): A Selenium-powered bot that automates Omegle interactions, with support for automated chat responses. Tags: Python, Selenium, Automation
